operators.name: triu_forward
semantics: Implements torch.triu(x, diagonal=diagonal) elementwise: output[i,j,k,l] = x[i,j,k,l] if l >= k + diagonal else 0.
Input x is CUDA float32 tensor of shape (16,3,2048,1280) contiguous. diagonal is integer 1 for this task.
Output has same shape, dtype and device as input; zero-filled strictly below the specified diagonal.
The op reads x and writes a newly allocated output tensor; no broadcasting or reduction.

operators.name: sum_dim23_forward
semantics: Implements torch.sum(x, dim=(2,3)): sum over H and W dimensions, keeping batch and channel dimensions.
Input x is CUDA float32 tensor of shape (16,3,2048,1280) contiguous. Output shape (16,3).
Reduction sums along the last two dimensions for each (batch, channel) index.
Output tensor is new allocation, dtype float32, device cuda, contiguous.
Applies upper triangular masking with diagonal offset 1. For each 4D element, keep if last index >= second-to-last + 1, otherwise zero.
Output shape equals input (16,3,2048,1280), dtype float32, device cuda:0, stride preserves input stride.
Sum over dimensions 2 and 3 (H and W), resulting shape (16,3).
Reduction order follows torch.sum semantics, accumulating sequentially over last dims.
Output dtype float32, device cuda:0, stride [3,1] contiguous.
Returns the sum tensor as final output, shape (16,3) float32 cuda:0.
